name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: In Hillsbrad, Forsaken forces press their assault south. After strikes on the northern farms, Horde operatives hunt the peasants fleeing to the orchards.

sections.title: Sowing Terror in the Fields
sections.body: The attack on Hillsbrad's human farms drives laborers south into the fields. After the northern farms are struck, many flee to the orchards and pastures of Hillsbrad Fields, hoping to escape the advancing undead. High Executor Darthalia sees their flight as a chance to break the township's remaining labor force and morale.

sections.title: The Dark Lady's Advance
sections.body: From Tarren Mill, High Executor Darthalia orders Horde forces to hunt the displaced laborers in the fields. The peasants have no protection, and their deaths choke Hillsbrad's food supply and weaken civilian resolve. For Darthalia and the Forsaken, each human killed tightens their hold over the surviving township and helps keep Lordaeron in Forsaken hands.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken targeting simple peasants?
faq.answer: The Forsaken target the peasants to destroy the labor force that feeds Hillsbrad. By killing those hiding in the southern orchards, High Executor Darthalia deepens the town's panic and hunger, making conquest easier.
High Executor Darthalia, the Forsaken commander at Tarren Mill, orders the assault on local human settlements in the name of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Where did these peasants flee from?
faq.answer: The peasants fled the northern farms after earlier Horde strikes. In panic, they sought refuge among the trees and pastures of southern Hillsbrad Fields.

faq.q: Where can the fleeing peasants be found?
faq.answer: The peasants are scattered through the southern orchards and pastures of Hillsbrad Fields, just south of the main road through the foothills.

faq.q: What comes after killing the peasants?
faq.answer: After the laborers are cleared from the southern fields, High Executor Darthalia turns the campaign toward Blacksmith Verringtan and the smithy arming Hillsbrad's defenders. The fighting moves closer to the town center.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting so ruthlessly here?
faq.answer: The human town of Hillsbrad is one of the last Alliance strongholds in Lordaeron. The Forsaken claim the region as their sovereign territory and seek to drive out or kill Alliance enclaves that threaten their southern border.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, killing the living laborers is practical and absolute. It denies the Alliance sustenance and strengthens the Dark Lady's rule over southern Lordaeron.
Tarren Mill is the Horde's stronghold in the foothills. Breaking Hillsbrad keeps Horde lines of communication and supply secure against Alliance incursions.
The killing of unarmed refugees in the southern orchards shows the Forsaken's ruthless war against Lordaeron's remaining living subjects.
